name_reason: Convention-compliant data_fd2_battle_<descriptor> for a battle-core scratch global, byte-identical to the live Ghidra symbol. 'ai_best_item_target_x' accurately conveys role (best AI offensive-item target tile X coordinate) and the data is a scalar coordinate. The '_x' suffix is a semantic coordinate axis (paired with _y @0x53C3B), NOT Ghidra address residue; no hex address tail is embedded. keep.
element_semantics: Single unsigned tile X coordinate. Written as a full dword from a byte tile coord zero-extended via MOVZX; also rewritten in-place to a computed (and signed-clamped) tile X during the long-range projectile interpolation path.
purpose: Battle AI scratch state: X tile coordinate of the best offensive ITEM-use target chosen by enemy AI. First target member of the ai_best_item_* result group (X @0x53C37, Y @0x53C3B, score @0x53C33, slot @0x53C3F).
logic_summary: fd2_ai_score_item_use (@0x15811) evaluates every offensive inventory item x every reachable target tile and, whenever a candidate beats the running best score, stores the winning tile X here (source byte coord zero-extended via MOVZX @0x1583A). fd2_execute_ai_item_use then reads it (@0x150EB/0x1510E/0x15155/0x15281) to drive AOE/projectile target resolution; on the long-range projectile path it rewrites it in-place as cursor_world_x + (range_class-0x10)*(x - cursor_world_x) and clamps it signed to [0, data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles-1]. Mutable (game-side writers present), so non-const.
comment_original_issue: None. The existing src comment block (btl_ai.c group header lines 735-743 plus per-symbol block lines 745-754) is already precise and accurate: it correctly states the 0x53C37 address, the dword store of a zero-extended byte coord (MOV [0x53C37],EAX @0x15811 with MOVZX @0x1583A), the multiple reads, the in-place projectile rewrite, the signed clamp to map_width_tiles-1, the unsigned-tile-coord semantics, group membership, and the ai_best_spell_target_x analogue. All claims verified against the disassembly.
notes: Verified via disassembly of fd2_ai_score_item_use: 0x15808 MOV [0x53C33],EAX (score); 0x15811 MOV [0x53C37],EAX (target_x, EAX from [ESP+0x40]); 0x1581A MOV [0x53C3B],EAX (target_y); 0x1581F MOV [0x53C3F],EAX (slot); 0x1583A MOVZX EBP,byte ptr [EAX] -> [ESP+0x40] confirms the byte->dword zero-extension. xrefs: reads/writes only from fd2_execute_ai_item_use (READ x5, WRITE x3 for the projectile-path in-place rewrite/clamp) and fd2_ai_score_item_use (WRITE). Ghidra DTYPE=undefined4 len=4, SYM matches src byte-identical, plate was <null> so created a concise data plate (cu.setComment PLATE_COMMENT) mirroring the src conclusion; Ghidra program saved. src comment left unchanged (verdict=keep), so only the shard is committed.
